purpose: Define a point-in-time-safe feature-snapshot boundary without ingesting raw records or implementing runtime scoring.

candidate_snapshot.unknown_policy: Unknown remains explicit; it is not converted to zero, false, or an empty category.

proposed_transformations.name: reference_pseudonymisation
proposed_transformations.constraint: Requires an approved key-management and retention policy; never use unhashed source IDs outside the source boundary.

proposed_transformations.name: money_normalisation
proposed_transformations.constraint: Requires source amount-sign semantics, ISO exponent, and rounding approval.

proposed_transformations.name: merchant_category_normalisation
proposed_transformations.input: provider primary/detailed category and corpus category
proposed_transformations.constraint: Requires a versioned taxonomy and explicit unknown policy.

proposed_transformations.name: history_and_velocity_aggregation
proposed_transformations.input: prior eligible facts for an approved pseudonymous entity
proposed_transformations.constraint: Each input must have available_at strictly before as_of; this is not proven by the observed Plaid data.

parity_test_cases: A date-only event cannot produce time-of-day or hourly velocity features.
A future, corrected, removed, or late-available record is ineligible for an earlier snapshot.
A missing category, payee, country, or event time stays unknown.
The historical and online transformations must share the same named version before a feature is eligible.
decision_recommendation: No reusable runtime enrichment code or online features are approved. Review the mapping and feature matrix first.
